newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Merger impact on margins limited-Novartis.
newsitem.headline: Merger impact on margins limited-Novartis.

text.p: Novartis AG, the pharmaceuticals and life sciences group formed by the merger of Sandoz and Ciba-Geigy, said operating income rose by four percent in 1996 and the merger had limited impact on margins.

Operating income for its life sciences division rose by four percent to 5.6 billion Swiss francs ($3.8 billion) and margins, at 20.4 percent, were in line with management expectations, Novartis said in a statement.
It also said group Research and Development (R&D) spending rose by four percent. R&D spending in the pharmaceuticals sector was maintained at 19 percent of sales.

In addition, marketing expenditures were increased by seven percent for launches of fast-growing products, as well as for additions to the sales force, the Novartis statement said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340 ($ = 1.459 Swiss Francs)
